title: Hexagon
subtitle: Six sides, flat top
description: A true flat-topped hexagon: a horizontal edge at the top and the bottom, straight flanks between them, and a point at each side. The taper reaches the vertical middle, which is what makes it six sides.

The shape this replaced tapered only a quarter of the way in and then ran its flanks straight up to the top edge -- so at node size it was an octagon wearing a hexagon's name. Flat-topped because then its width is the node's width, the horizontal weight an item sprite wants; regular, so it keeps a few rows of air above and below rather than being stretched to fill.
